name: Forever Growing Garden
summary: Some hardware companies often published their own games in order to bundle them with their hardware (when they couldn't get enough big-name games to sign with them). This is one such product. Forever growing garden's gameplay consists of selecting seeds, etc. and taking care of them in order to later sell your crops on the market and flowershop (were you can also make flower-arrangements, etc.) the game is aimed at kids, so everything from the interface to the objectives are kept very simple and straight-forward. Also the game is filled with hot-spots that start animations or sound effects.
